/de so so'i dpangs la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu re yod la/ bzhi ka dbyibs zlum po dang mtha' skor sum 'gyur te/ rlung mthar 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang*/ me mthar 'bum phrag dgu dang*/ chu mthar 'bum phrag drug dang*/ sa mthar 'bum phrag gsum yod cing 'og mas steng ma skyong ba'i tshur gyis so/ /lhun po chu'i nang du nub pa lta bu ma yin par sa dkyil de'i dbus su gnas la/ lhun po'i rtsa ba'i thad ka'i zhing la dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug ste don la chig khri drug stong*/ mtha'i khor yug gi zhing la stong phrag gcig /lhun po'i dpangs la dpag tshad 'bum/ bsil ri'i steng gi thad kar lhun po'i zheng la dpag tshad lnga khri/ lhun po'i rked pa nas rim gyis stong je sbom du song ste steng gi thad kar dpag tshad 'bum/ dbyibs zlum po/ shar in+d+ra nī la/ lho pad+ma rā ga dmar po/ nub karke ta ser po/ byang zla ba chu shel dkar po/ dbus margad ljang khu/ ri rab kyi steng gi phyogs mtshams su brgya byin sogs phyogs skyong bcu/ lhun po'i khor yug gi mtha' nas phyi'i bsil ri'i bar la dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug yod pa de cha bco brgyad du phye ba la zlum por rim pa bzhin du gling mtsho ri gsum gsum ste/ nang nas phyir zla ba'i gling dang sbrang rtsi'i mtsho dang 'od sngon gyi ri gsum/ de bzhin du 'od dkar gling mar gyi mtsho man+da ra'i re/ ku sha'i gling zho'i mtsho ni ṣa'i ri/ mi'i nyi'i gling 'o ma'i mtsho nor bu'i ri/ khrung khrung gling chu'i mtsho dro ba'i ri/ drag po'i gling chang gi mtsho bsil ri'o/ /lhun po'i steng gi zheng dpag tshad lnga khrir 'dod pa yod kyang 'bum yod pa'i lugs 'dir lhun po'i kha khyer gyi 'og gi khongs skyibs na ri mtsho gling rnams yod de/ sa dkyil gyi zheng la'ang dpag tshad 'bum yod pas de'i zheng dang lhun po'i steng gi zheng tshad mnyam pa'i phyir

ro/ /bsil ri'i phyir gling bcu gnyis po bsdoms pa la 'dzam gling chen po zhes bya'o/ /gling de rnams kyi bar chus bcad pa ma yin par 'brel nas yod pa'i gling so so'i dbus su rang rang mtshon byed kyi mtshan ma shar na zla gam/ lhor gru gsum/ byang du zlum po/ nub tu gru bzhi pa ste rim pa bzhin du zheng dpag tshad stong phrag bdun dang brgyad dgu dang bcu'o/ /lho gling dbus ma 'di la 'dzam gling chung ngu zhes bya la/ mtshams bzhi'i gling la nye ba'i gling zhes brjod do/ / spyir phyogs bzhi'i gling rnams ngos gsum ma'i tshul du gnas kyang khyim 'khor lugs kyis ngos gnyis par yang 'gyur ro/ /ri rab kyi rtsa ba'i dbus kyi tshangs thig nas gling rnams kyi mtha'i bar dpag tshad lnga khri re yod de/ de nas sa dkyil gyi mtha'i bar de tsam re yod pas so/ /'dzam gling 'di'i lho byang gi tshad la dpag tshad nyis khri lnga stong yod pa'i dbus phyed nas byang ngos su dpag tshad khri dang nyis stong lnga brgya'i sa cha de dum bu drug tu phye ba la yul drug gnas te/ byang nas rim pa bzhin du gangs can dang sham bha la dang rgya nag dang li dang bod dang 'phags yul lo/ /zhib na bod 'di lho gling shar ma na yod par bshad/ phyed kyi lhor khri dang nyis stong lnga brgya'i sar 'gro ba ci rigs dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni stong pa'i sar bshad de/ phyogs gzhan yang ci ltar rigs par mtshon no/ /gling rnams kyi mtha' nas chu me rlung dkyil gsum po snga ma las phyi ma dpag tshad snga bcur rim par phyir 'phags so/ /rlung dkyil gyi 'og tu rdo rje'i kha rtse'i dmyal ba yod cing*/ dmyal ba gzhan bdun ni rlung me chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cha la gnas par bshad de mi mthun pa yod do/ /sa dkyil gyi phyed gong gi khong seng nas lha min dang phyed man na klu gnas so/ /sa steng na mi dang bsil ri sogs kyi steng du rim par 'dod lha drug dang*/

de'i gong du gzugs dang gzugs med kyi lha rnams gnas so/ /bsil ri 'di mngon pa'i lugs kyis mu khyud 'dzin ri'i dod do/ /nyi zla rgyu skar rnams bsil ri'i phyi rol dpag tshad chig khri nyis stong lnga brgya tshun nas khyon de tsam nam mkhar g.yas skor gyis rgyu ste/ zhib par mi 'chad cing phal cher ni sngar ltar ro/ /'on kyang 'di ba'i lugs kyi zhag gsum gyi khyad par cung zad bshad na/ mi dkyus ma zhig gi dbugs 'byung 'jug gnyis gcig tu byas pa la dbugs gcig /de drug longs pa la chu spang gcig /de drug cur chu tshod gcig /de drug cu longs pa'i tshad la nyin zhag gcig tu 'jog cing*/ mdor na dbugs nyis khri chig stong drug brgya'i tshad la nyin zhag gcig ste/ ngo bo ni nam langs nas nam langs kyi bar la 'jog go /zla ba 'phel 'grib byed pa'i dkar nag gi cha bco lnga bco lnga res bzhag pa'i cha rer chu tshod nga dgu/ chu srang gsum/ dbugs lnga/ ri mkha' ri'i cha bcu drug re ste tshes zhag gcig /nyi mas go la'i rgyu skar gyi khyim bcu gnyis g.yon skor du bgrod pa'i khyim rer khyim zla re dang*/ de la cha sum cur phye ba'i cha rer chu tshod drug cu/ chu srang gnyis/ dbugs bzhi/ ri mkha' ri'i cha brgya re brgyad/ mda' ro'i cha lnga bcu rnams bsdoms pa'i yun ni khyim zhag gcig /de sum cu la khyim zla gcig /de drug la bgrod pa re/ bgrod gnyis la zla ba bcu gnyis te bsdoms pas khyim lo gcig go khyim lo de la nyin zhag sum brgya re lnga/ chu tshod bcu drug /chu srang bcu bzhi/ dbugs gcig /'dod cha bcu gnyis/ ri mkha' ri'i cha brgya nyer gcig dang*/ tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig /chu tshod bzhi/ chu srang so drug /dbugs lnga/ 'dod cha bdun rnams 'byung ngo*/ /mngon pa'i lugs kyi zhag gcig la skad cig ma sa ya gsum dang nyis 'bum bzhi khri 'byung ba der dbugs nyis khri chig stong drug brgyas bgos na thob nor brgya lnga bcu 'byung yang*/

dbugs gcig gi yun la skad cig ma brgya lnga bcu rdzogs shin tu dka' bas mngon pa'i lugs de rags rtsis su gsal zhing don ni khyim zhag gcig la dgongs par mngon te/ nyin zhag la tshul de mi bde bar shes so/ khyim bcu gnyis kyi rgyu skar rnams rlung 'gros kyi g.yas skor yin kyang*/ rang 'gros ni nyi mas rgyu skar la g.yon skor du longs spyod pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa ste/ rags rim tsam zhig bdag gis dus tshigs kyi yig cha logs su bris yod pa der bshad zin pas 'dir de tsam mo/ /'o na rnam gzhag mi 'dra ba de dag 'gal lo zhe na/ 'di dag gi 'gal spong gzhan gyis ci rigs bshad cing khyad par du mkhas grub rjes dus 'khor ṭika chen sogs las bshad pa ltar yin pas rgyas par 'dir mi brjod kyang*/ mtshon tsam ni de ltar mi 'dra bar bshad kyang skyon med de/ gdul bya mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis yin pa'i phyir te/ mngon pa'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i snang ngor rang gi gzhung nas bshad pa'i ri gling sogs kyi rnam pa can du snang la/ dus 'khor gyi gdul bya'i ngor yang rang gi lugs kyi ri gling sogs kyi rnam par snang ba 'byung zhing*/ de las gzhan pa'i gdul bya la'ang rigs 'gre ba'i phyir/ dper na/ las can gyi lha mi yi dwags gsum gyis brlan zhing gsher ba phor pa gang la bltas pa'i tshe brlan gsher de nyid lha'i ngor bdud rtsi dang*/ mi'i ngor chu dang*/ yi dwags kyi ngor rnag khra lta bur snang ba 'byung zhing de dngos gnas pa gsum yang grub pa bzhin no/ /de yang sems can spyi mthun dang*/ so so'i las dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi 'phrul dang smon lam dang mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas rang rang gi lugs gang gtso bor byed pa de dang bstun nas khas blang bar bya'i 'gal bar mi bsam ste/ ji skad du/ skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang*/

/bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /zhes pa dang*/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /smras pa/ ji ltar nam kha'i khams nyid la/ /mtha' dbus med pa ji bzhin du/ /sems can rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /grangs kyang pha mtha'i tshad dang bral/ /sems can las sam sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam mthus/ /snod bcud bkod pa sna tshogs zhig /sgyu ma mig 'phrul lta bur snang*/ /de yi rnam gzhag mdo nyid dang*/ /bstan bcos dag las mang bshad kyang*/ /'dir ni de las snying po tsam/ /bsdus nas mkhas pa'i dgongs bzhin smras/ /de yang legs bshad don gnyer ba'i/ /blo ldan 'ga' yi don phyir te/ /dge kun gzhan la phan ched dang*/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /ces snod bcud kyi rnam gzhag cung zad bstan pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sngar rang gis byas pa'i mdzod kyi ṭīk+ka nas logs su phyung ste 'og mjug tu bsnon ma cung zad dang bcas co ne dgon nyid du sbyar ba'o/ /maṅgalaṃ bha wān+tu/ dge'o// //
